# 1.37.0-beta.3

Third beta of 1.37.0: security and privacy.

## Autostart audit

- Ask the agent to audit autostart. It checks everything that starts on its own: services, scheduled tasks, Run keys, startup folders, WMI subscriptions and Chrome, Edge and Firefox extensions. Only the risks are listed: files without a valid signature, files in places an ordinary user can write to, and extensions that did not come from the store.
- Windows files signed through system catalogs count as signed, and no signature check goes online.
- Listing and inspecting scheduled tasks now reads the Task Scheduler directly: paths and names with Cyrillic or other non-Latin letters arrive intact instead of as question marks, in one English table that is no longer cut off halfway through the list.

## Audit log

- Every line of the audit log now carries the hash of the line before it. The Audit tab of the journal says whether the chain is intact or names the month and line where it breaks, so an edited or deleted line shows.
- Importing a data archive now adds its audit lines through the same journal the app writes to, so a line written at the same moment is no longer lost.
- Each action is also copied to the Windows Application log, so an administrator sees what the AI did with standard Windows tools. Arguments stay out of it: only the tool, the outcome, who approved it, SynGuard, the agent, the machine and the line's hash. Settings > Security > Privacy > Copy to Windows log turns it off.

## Policies for organizations

- Administrators can set policies through the registry (HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Amarin\Admin AI) or the ADMX template attached to every release (Amarin-Admin-AI-v1.37.0-beta.3-policies.zip for this one): forced read-only mode, tools turned off, allowed providers and models, no mouse control, and a forced copy to the Windows log.
- A blocked provider or model gets no request at all and is hidden from the model pickers and the add key window. Settings > Security shows one line when the organization sets something and locks the controls it sets.
- Policies apply to every profile on the computer and take effect after the app restarts.
